name: alexshop.me
body: Every internal link that was opened answered, and AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page. But 17 form controls have no label.
lesson: Give every input a visible label tied to it with for and id. Screen readers announce it, and the tap target grows.
summary: alexshop.me scores 71 out of 100 (C). 5 checks fail now, 26 are at risk, and 38 pass. Fix first: 17 form controls have no label.

fix.title: 17 form controls have no label
fix.evidence: On /en/outlet, /en/products?isSwiss=true, /en/general-info/sales-terms, /en/products/aigner and 13 more. Screen readers announce them as an unnamed field.
fix.fix: Pair each control with <label for>, wrap it in a label, or add aria-label.

fix.title: Elements must only use supported ARIA attributes
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 7 elements on /en/outlet, /en/products?isSwiss=true, for example #headlessui-combobox-button-_R_doll5ud9qivb_ and #headlessui-checkbox-_R_6cnl5ud9qivb_ > .custom-checkbox__label > .custom-checkbox. Impact: critical.

fix.title: Buttons must have discernible text
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 2 elements on /en/outlet, /en/products?isSwiss=true, for example .custom-combobox__button. Impact: critical.
fix.fix: Give each icon button visible text or an aria-label.

fix.title: Analytics may count some visits twice
fix.evidence: 20 pages load gtag.js more than once.
fix.fix: Keep one GA4 property per site and load gtag.js once, or manage it only inside Tag Manager.

fix.title: Elements must meet minimum color contrast ratio thresholds
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 35 elements on /en, /en/outlet, /en/products?isSwiss=true, for example .product-tag__limited-edition and .site-footer-desktop__rating > .google-rating-link[rel="noopener noreferrer"][target="_blank"]:nth-child(1) > .google-ra. Impact:…
fix.fix: Darken the text or lighten the background until normal text reaches 4.5:1 and large text 3:1.

fix.title: 58 images have no width or height
fix.evidence: The layout jumps when they load, which hurts Cumulative Layout Shift.
fix.fix: Set width and height (or aspect-ratio) on images.

works.title: Every internal link that was opened answered
AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page
Front-end libraries have no known flaw
Every image has an alt attribute
Images are no more than twice the size shown
Every page has a meta description
